title: China and the US alter foreign aid strategies
summary: China's foreign aid strategy has shifted in the last few decades and now its model may be the one the US is adopting as China moves away from it.
contentText:
China's foreign aid strategy has shifted in the last few decades Now its model may be the one the U.S. is adopting even as China moves away from it.
